title: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate fee (Fire Code fee)
notes: National Fire Code fee, not a city imposition: 10% of all fees charged by the LGU in granting the business permit. Engine computes this LAST over the sum of mayors_permit + regulatory group lines on the same assessment. The city ordinance contains no BFP fee schedule.

title: Community tax — corporations (gross-receipts component + basic)
notes: P500 basic + P2 per P5,000 of gross receipts (rate 0.0004), capped at P10,000 including the real-property component. The real-property component (P2 per P5,000 of assessed value) is NOT computed here — the application does not capture assessed property value; officers add it via fee adjustment when applicable. Dividends count as gross receipts per Sec. 7.03. Bills only juridical entities (corporation/partnership); sole proprietors owe the individual community tax (Sec. 7.02), a personal obligation outside this assessment.

title: Community tax — newly-registered corporations (basic only)
notes: New business has no preceding-year gross receipts; only the P500 basic community tax applies in year one. Real-property component via officer adjustment when applicable. Bills only juridical entities (corporation/partnership); sole proprietors owe the individual community tax (Sec. 7.02), a personal obligation outside this assessment.

title: Surcharge and interest on late payment
notes: Constants consumed by FeeCalculator::latePenalty(), not emitted as an assessment line at filing time: one-time surcharge 25% of the amount due (Sec. 8A.04); interest up to 2% per month on the unpaid amount including surcharge, total interest capped at 36 months / 72% (Sec. 8A.05).

title: Presumptive Income Level assessment (officer-set)
notes: requires_officer: the ordinance delegates the PIL minimum-gross-sales schedule to the City Treasury (approved by the Local Finance Committee); the schedule is not printed in the ordinance, so no amount can be computed here. A renewal declaring no gross sales gets this P0 line and the officer sets the assessed amount via fee adjustment. Declaring gross sales below PIL is also a permit-denial ground (Sec. 3A.05).
defects: Sec. 2O.01 'SCHEDULE OF MINIMUM GROSS SALES' heading has no table printed; delegated to City Treasury (Appendix A).

title: BMBE exemption claim (officer-reviewed)
notes: requires_officer: RA 9178 exempts registered BMBEs from income tax and ENCOURAGES (does not mandate) LGU reduction/exemption of local taxes and fees. A10-2016 grants no automatic BMBE exemption, so business tax is still computed; this P0 line records the claim (BMBE Certificate of Authority required) and the officer applies any reduction via fee adjustment.

title: Cooperative exemption claim (officer-reviewed)
notes: requires_officer: duly registered cooperatives transacting with members only are exempt from local taxes under RA 9520 Art. 61; those transacting with non-members are taxed per their CDA registration and exemption certificate. Business tax is still computed; this P0 line records the claim (CDA certificate required) and the officer zeroes or reduces lines via fee adjustment.

title: Petroleum business exemption (automatic)
notes: Automatic by the ordinance itself: businesses engaged in production, manufacture, refining, distribution or sale of petroleum products are exempt from the Article J graduated tax (engine suppresses biztax.* lines when this flag is set and emits this P0 citation line). Regulatory and permit fees still apply.
